artworks.title: In the Sierras, A Pack Train
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures on horseback traveling through a wooded area. The scene is viewed from an elevated angle, showing the path on which the riders are moving. The horizon is low, with a hint of mountains or hills visible beyond the trees. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, resembling a sketch. The color palette consists of muted earth tones like brown, gray, and sepia. The figures are on a winding trail, surrounded by trees depicted with dynamic linear strokes, evoking movement through the natural landscape.

artworks.title: West Point from Storm King
artworks.medium: graphite on light green wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketched from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, featuring distant hills and mountains. Close-up, there are undulating terrains with light pencil lines marking contours. The pencil strokes are delicate and minimalistic, capturing natural forms. The color palette is limited to shades of gray, focusing on form and structure.

artworks.title: Angel - Trinity Church Mural
artworks.medium: charcoal, graphite, and pen and brown ink, squared with graphite
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed drawing of a person's upper three-quarters body. The figure is seated with their right arm raised, holding a large scroll or piece of cloth against their body. The face is turned slightly to the side with delicate features and a serene expression. The person has styled hair with soft curls around the face. The clothing is a draped garment, and there are wings behind the figure. The surroundings include a grid pattern and other sketches and shapes in the background.

artworks.title: Study for Moses - Trinity Church, Boston
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a person from head to toe. The body is facing forward and is partly obscured by lines. The facial features, eyes, and a beard are visible, with long hair. The person appears to be wearing a flowing robe, with bold shading on the lower portion. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is a textured surface, emphasizing the person in the sketch.

artworks.title: Trinity Church, Boston (nave) - Mural Study
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and brown ink, and brush and brown ink on gray-blue wove paper
artworks.description: This image shows a detailed architectural sketch with intricate carvings and designs on a wall. The focus is on the ornate panels and columns in the center and towards the right. The view is slightly elevated, with a suggestion of significant height from an arch in the upper section. The drawing uses thin lines to depict the architectural elements and is rendered in black ink on muted blue paper, highlighting the details. The image emphasizes the complexity and beauty of the designs through precise renderings.

artworks.title: Eastman Johnson Sketching
artworks.medium: graphite and touches of black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper body in profile view. The person is seated and appears focused, with their body slightly angled forward. They have distinct facial features, curly hair, a formal outfit, and one arm extended forward holding a pencil or similar object. The background is plain, emphasizing the sketched figure.

artworks.title: Ten Heads
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features nine facial sketches with different expressions and hairstyles. The sketches show head and shoulder representations with no bodies depicted. The faces have various orientations, including front-facing, profile, and angled views. The hairstyles range from straight to curly, with different lengths, and one sketch shows a man with a beard and mustache. Minimal clothing details are visible, with simple lines suggesting collars or necklines, and one figure is wearing a cap. No jewelry is depicted, and the sketches appear on a plain brown paper background. The artist's signature "George Luks" is at the bottom left of the image. The sketches are in black lines, likely drawn with a pencil or similar medium.

artworks.title: Old Crossing, Otter Tail River
artworks.medium: black chalk touched with white chalk on brown  wove paper
artworks.description: This is a pencil sketch of a riverside scene. The drawing portrays a calm landscape from a distant, elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is near the top, with small buildings lining it, suggesting a gentle slope. A river meanders from left to right, near us, with a boat on the bank. The sketch features thin, detailed lines for textures of earth and foliage. The monochrome color palette on brown paper creates a sepia tone, adding to the tranquility. Simple strokes highlight natural forms, enhancing the serene effect of the scene.

artworks.title: Raven Hill
artworks.medium: graphite on green wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch from an elevated viewpoint, overlooking distant hills. The scene includes sparse trees on a gentle slope, with softly contoured hills stretching into the distance. The sketch is done using delicate pencil lines on beige paper, creating a subdued and tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Upper Saranac Lake
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lakeside scene from a slightly elevated perspective. There is a horizon line just below the center, with a lake reflecting trees and distant hills. The artwork is done in a soft pencil sketch style, with delicate brushstrokes capturing the landscape. The color palette is limited to natural tones of a graphite pencil on off-white paper. The lake reflects trees nearby, and hills rise in the distance under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Meadow Pond, New York
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a serene landscape with a water body and a horizon line. Delicate, bare trees are depicted with intricate details reflected in the calm water. The monochromatic palette emphasizes light and shadow, created with fine pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Selina, Countess of Huntindon
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the waist up, with her head turned slightly to her right. She has a serene expression with age lines on her face, and a subtle smile. She wears a bonnet with ruffles, an elegant cloak with fur, and a draped fabric. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with a crown at the top. Below the frame are ornate details including a trumpet, cross, crown on an open book with legible text, and decorative swirls. The background is shaded with stylized pillars or walls.

artworks.title: American Observing Station, Kerquelen Islands
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and black wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with water, mountains, two sailboats, and a house on a hillside. The brushstrokes are soft and blended, creating a tranquil scene. The color palette is monochrome, with various shades of grey emphasizing light and shadow. In the distance, there are rugged mountains, one with a light dusting on top. Reflections of the sails are visible in the water, and the sky has soft, layered clouds.

artworks.title: On Board of the Stony Brook Packet
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a serene scene with sailboats on a calm body of water. The perspective is low, showing a horizon with sailboats spread across it. The sketch is delicate with finely penciled lines. The color palette is muted, mainly light beige and gray. The water closest to us has a subtle texture with faint ripples. In the distance, sailboats suggest a distant shore or harbor. Handwritten notes on the lower edge add authenticity to the image.

artworks.title: Nelson Mathewson
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man from the waist up, facing forward. He has a full, oval face with dark eyes and a slight smile. His hair is wavy, parted on the side, and framing his face with curls. He is dressed in a jacket, waistcoat, high-collared shirt, and a cravat or bow tie. The background is plain, focusing on the subject. The artist's signature and the year 1839 are visible below the portrait.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person, positioned facing the viewer. The person's features are depicted in a stylized, somewhat abstract manner, with a focus on the eyes, nose, and mouth. The details are subdued, giving the face a contemplative appearance with slightly downturned lips and a furrowed brow. The hair is dark and appears to be medium length. The person seems to be wearing a simple garment, though details of clothing are not evident due to the indistinct shading. There are no visible accessories or objects being held. The background is a textured, dark wash with little discernible detail, emphasizing the face. The bottom left corner contains the artist's signature, "Jerome Myers" and the date "1906."

artworks.title: Archer, Nude Study
artworks.medium: charcoal and black chalk heightened with white gouache on brown wove paper

artworks.title: Signature, "TH. Nast, Oct. 17, 1901"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on back of a Union League Club card
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person from the side view, depicted in mid-air with arms outstretched in front and legs bent behind. The person has simple facial features, spiky hair, and wears a coat and pants. Swirling lines around the figure suggest motion or wind. The background is plain with a signature and date “Thu: Nast, Oct 17, 1901” written to the right of the figure.

artworks.title: Gideon Fairman
artworks.medium: charcoal, pen and brown ink, touched with white gouache, on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in portrait format. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a strong jawline, deep-set eyes, and curly dark hair styled neatly. He is wearing a formal outfit with a high-collared shirt and a dark coat draped over his shoulder like a cape. The background is a plain, dark gradient with a lighter area behind his head, drawing focus to his face. No jewelry or other objects are present with the man in the portrait.

artworks.title: R. Strong
artworks.medium: graphite and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a chair, reading a book. He has short, wavy hair brushed back, and is wearing a dark jacket, a white shirt, and a cravat or necktie. The man is in profile, with his eyes closed as he reads, and the background is textured.

artworks.title: Interior, Fitzwilliam Museum
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an art gallery or museum interior displaying classical sculptures. The drawing shows an interior space filled with classical sculptures and relief panels, showcasing objects displayed on pedestals and within glass cases. The walls are adorned with carved reliefs, while the ceiling features ornate detailing reminiscent of classical architecture, supported by tall fluted columns. Light and shadows play across the surfaces, emphasizing the three-dimensional nature of the art objects. The overall atmosphere conveys admiration for classical art, capturing the grandeur and elegance of the museum or gallery setting.

artworks.title: Study of a Hand
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white chalk on green  wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a human hand resting on a flat surface with a pencil nearby. The hand is detailed with contours and skin texture, and the fingers are slightly curled. The pencil is placed parallel to the wrist. The drawing uses precise lines and gradients for a 3D effect, and the paper texture complements the lines.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a path winding through tall trees. The dense forest fills the space without a visible horizon. The detailed brushstrokes depict textures of tree bark, foliage, and rocks. The color palette is warm and muted, with earthy tones dominating. A small stream flows over rocks in the foreground, surrounded by dense vegetation.

artworks.title: Hudson River Landing [recto]
artworks.medium: pen with gray and black ink on laid paper torn from a book
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a large building on the left, a sailboat anchored to the right, and another sailboat on the horizon. The illustration uses fine linework with a color palette of beige and gray. Rocks line the shore with hatching for texture, and hills are visible in the background.
